title: BodySettings
description: Data file content/body/settings.json (B5-11, spec Bogen 30 R29/R30, D1084): what the weather does to an inhabitant's body beyond the air - rain wets it unless it is under shelter, it dries by a table over the temperature (faster in wind), and being wet cools; the sun warms where nothing casts shade (trees by shade_height_cm and crown_radius_cm in the direction of the sun table, no angle functions). All numbers are data; no fear of water (R30), no behaviour - what an inhabitant does about it stays with the decider (B2584).

cover.description: How much a shade caster covers, by type and season (TL #25357: a broad-leaved tree in winter little): it dims the sun in its shade and the rain under its crown. A caster or season not listed covers fully (1000).

rain_per_hour.description: How fast rain wets an inhabitant out in the open, in permille of fully wet per game hour.

drying.description: How fast a wet inhabitant dries, by the air temperature: the first band whose below_tenth_c is above the temperature; the last (below_tenth_c null) takes the rest.

wind_drying_permille.description: Extra drying at full wind, in permille of the band's rate.

cool_tenth_c.description: How much colder it feels when fully wet, in tenths of a degree (linear with the wetness).

shelter_property.description: The TRUE property of things that keep the rain off whoever stands at them.

shelter_radius_cm.description: How near such a thing must be.

per_hour.description: Permille of fully wet that dries per game hour.

warm_tenth_c.description: How much warmer it feels in the sun under a clear sky, in tenths of a degree (less with clouds, none in shade).

positions.description: Where the sun stands, by season and hour: the latest entry of the season at or before the hour holds; before the first and from an entry without a direction on, the sun is down.

toward_x_permille.description: Direction the shadows fall (x part); null with z null = the sun is down.

shadow_permille.description: Length of a shadow per height (low sun: long shadows).
